name: Glimmer
description: Gives every narrow band of the spectrum its own small tremolo, so the sound holds its level while its partials catch the light and let it go.

params.name: Depth
params.description: How far each band of the spectrum dips between its flashes. Low is a faint sheen; at full every band falls to silence and comes back.

params.name: Rate
params.description: How fast the bands flicker. Slow is drifting weather inside the sound; fast is a shimmer on its surface.

params.name: Grain
params.description: How narrow the flickering bands are. Low moves broad regions of the spectrum together; high lets single partials flicker on their own.

params.name: Pattern
params.description: Scatter flickers every band in its own time. Upward and Downward send a ripple through the spectrum, and Outward sends it both ways from the middle.

params.name: Lean
params.description: Which part of the spectrum flickers most. To the right the lows hold steady under glittering highs; to the left the highs hold steady.

params.name: Soft
params.description: How gently each band comes and goes. High is a smooth swell and fall; low is a short sudden glint with dark around it.

params.name: Vary
params.description: How unlike one flash is to the next. At zero a band flashes as brightly every time; higher lets some flashes come dim or stay away.

params.name: Apart
params.description: How differently the two sides flicker. At zero both sides move as one; higher spreads the flicker across the stereo field.

params.name: Mix
params.description: Balance between the untouched sound and the flickering one.

origin.note: A tremolo for every narrow band of the spectrum on kit::Stft, each band on its own seeded clock, with the long-term power of every band held.
